integrity: The universal statements are proved analytically from an explicit competitor. Bundled numerical root evaluations are reproducibility checks only and are not used to turn finite computation into an infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives one-sided analytic upper fences for the first transition and an asymptotic lower bound on the transition gap. It does not identify the exact global transition, prove monotonicity, or prove convergence to 2.
title: A split-pair upper fence for the first odd planar \(p\)-frame transition
